name: drobek
description: Build, preview and publish web apps in your drobek workspace over the drobek MCP server.

interface.longDescription: drobek is an open-source cloud workspace for web apps built by agents. Your agent creates an app in your drobek workspace, writes its files, gets the server-side compile result back on every write and hands you a live preview URL. Every change is an immutable version you can roll back to, and a version goes live on its production URL only when you ask for it.
defaultPrompt: Build a tip calculator on drobek
